API key is empty or the address is invalid. The switches below can be turned on but nothing will take effect; generation keeps using the original path.
Enabled takeovers run through Jev. Anything it fails or is unsure about silently falls back to the original logic.
A judgment-only model: it never writes text, it only picks and scores. Answering takes 70–500 ms and output tokens are free. It is a hidden layer inside the app and never shows up in the model list.
Any failure — network error, invalid key, unparsable response, or confidence below the threshold — silently falls back to the original logic. No error dialogs, no interruption to the conversation.
Judgments below this confidence are discarded and the original logic takes over. Applying judgment below the threshold is what causes wrong decisions.
Memory retrieval is judged by Jev instead of embedding similarity. Falls back to the original retrieval when a single judgment is missing.
Registers Jev as a judge tool on the main model, so it can make extra judgments mid-generation.
